title: Real Package, Wrong Controller: Static Auditing of Vendor--Protocol Mismatches in LLM-Generated PLC Code
abstract: arXiv:2611.33227v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models can generate Python that drives industrial protocols on programmable logic controllers, yet existing code-grounding checks ask whether an imported package or symbol exists rather than whether it suits the declared industrial target. We define \emph{metadata-conditioned, import-level vendor--protocol incompatibility} and build \textsc{Proteus-OT}, a label-free static verifier over a version-pinned graph of documented bindings. Across 883 generated scripts, 180 carry an import-level mismatch against the declared target (20.4\%); restricting to single-vendor targets gives 16.3\%, and additionally requiring the offending library to reach a protocol communication call gives 14.2\%, which we read as conditional on the corpus metadata rather than on verified intent. None of the 28 adjudicable human control files carries one, a sample too small to estimate a prevalence. Within the balanced subset, 96.6\% of mismatching scripts

translated_title: 真实的包，错误的控制器：LLM生成的PLC代码中供应商-协议不匹配的静态审计
translated_abstract: 语言模型可以生成驱动可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）上工业协议的Python代码，然而现有的代码落地检查只验证导入的包或符号是否存在，而不验证它是否适合所声明的工业目标。我们定义了元数据条件下的导入级别供应商-协议不兼容性，并构建了Proteus-OT，这是一个基于版本固定的已文档化绑定图谱的无标签静态验证器。在883个生成的脚本中，有180个存在与声明目标不符的导入级别不匹配（20.4%）；限制为单一供应商目标时该比例为16.3%，若额外要求违规库能够触达协议通信调用，则比例为14.2%，我们将其解读为依赖于语料库元数据而非已验证的意图。28个可判定的人工编写的控制文件中没有一个存在此类问题，但样本量太小，无法估计该问题的普遍程度。在平衡子集中，96.6%的不匹配脚本（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 论文提出了Proteus-OT，一个基于版本固定绑定图谱的无标签静态验证器，用于检测大语言模型生成的PLC代码中导入包与声明工业控制器目标之间的供应商-协议不匹配，发现883个生成脚本中有20.4%存在此类导入级别不兼容问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Proteus-OT, a label-free static verifier built on a version-pinned graph of documented bindings, to detect vendor-protocol mismatches between imported packages and declared industrial controller targets in LLM-generated PLC code, finding that 20.4% of 883 generated scripts carry such import-level incompatibilities.
